title: Shared adversarial review-finding contract v1
description: Programme-neutral contract for one independent review finding and its current-head resolution. The contract owns the closed lens/outcome/severity/final-disposition vocabulary and the deterministic validation invariants binding every finding to the exact reviewed candidate head. Silence, a comment, or a later green workflow is not resolution: closing a finding requires current-head evidence. The contract does not submit reviews, retain threads, or decide mergeability. Finding instances are runtime-local outputs or durable GitHub review facts, never tracked live review state.

finding_id.description: Stable identity of this finding within the owning review.

reviewed_head.description: Exact candidate head this finding was raised against.

lens.description: Review lens this finding belongs to.

severity.description: Derived deterministically from the outcome; the composer asserts it and the validator recomputes it.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence identities and exact observations.

suggested_action.description: Concrete suggested action for the builder.

builder_response.description: Optional builder response; a response alone never resolves a finding.

resolution_head.description: Head the resolution evidence was observed against; must equal the reviewed head.

evidence.description: Current-head resolution evidence; prose alone never resolves a finding.

resolution.description: Required exactly when the final disposition claims resolution on the current head.

metadata.description: Non-semantic caller metadata; excluded from canonical identity and projections; never carries live review state.

finding_severity.description: Closed severity, derived from the outcome.

final_disposition.description: Closed terminal states of a finding within the owning review. instrument_failure may only stay open or be superseded by a re-run; it may never become a resolution.
